smart_box.name: SBBox-ReadingSession
smart_box.description: Smart Box responsible for maintaining the logical state and progress of a reader's session through the educational book.

page_id.description: Stable identifier of the current page.

reading_session.description: Current logical state and progress of the reading session.

rules: ReadingSession maintains the logical state of the current reading session.
A reading session has a stable session identifier.
The current page is identified by a stable page identifier.
Reading progress is derived from the logical position within the book.
ReadingSession uses BookCatalog to understand the logical book structure.
ReadingSession uses Navigation to obtain the current logical page position.
ReadingSession does not own page ordering.
ReadingSession does not control page navigation.
ReadingSession does not control narration playback.
ReadingSession does not render or load page images.
ReadingSession does not depend on a specific storage technology.
ReadingSession does not depend on a specific technology or provider.
ReadingSession exposes WHAT reading state is maintained, not HOW that state is stored.
